info.title: ky-ai-dotnet — run a .NET backend with output mirrored for agents.
info.description: .NET CLI dev-loop runner for AI agents: runs dotnet run/build with build state and logs exposed over MCP.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: SERVE — a backend's dev server (run one per app; registers with the hub for the agent):

options.name: --name
options.description: Project name in the hub (default: the .csproj / folder name)

options.name: --log-lines
options.description: Lines kept in the rolling log (default: 200; 0 = unlimited)

options.name: --log-file
options.description: Also mirror the rolling log to a file (default: off — MCP serves logs)

options.name: --no-watch
options.description: Use `dotnet run` instead of `dotnet watch run` (stable for debugging)

options.name: --hub-port
options.description: Hub port to register with (default: 5102; rarely needed — does not start a hub)

options.name: --no-hub
options.description:
Standalone: tee + rolling log + local REST only; no hub, no agent access
Anything else after `serve` is forwarded to dotnet (e.g. --project ./Api.csproj).
`dotnet watch run` hot-reloads; the agent verifies builds via the hub's wait_for_build.
